key.name: window-maximized
key.summary: Whether the window was maximized on last run
key.description: Whether the window was maximized on last run

key.name: window-width
key.description: Most recent window width

key.name: window-height
key.description: Most recent window height

key.name: composer-maximized
key.summary: Whether the composer was maximized on last run
key.description: Whether the composer was maximized on last run

key.name: composer-width
key.description: Most recent composer width

key.name: composer-height
key.description: Most recent composer height

key.name: background-notifications
key.description: If enabled, application continues running in the background after closing the window.

key.name: autostart
key.description: If enabled, application will be autostart during system startup.

key.name: view
key.description: Stores current view which will be used during application start to restore view.

key.name: account-order
key.description: Saves account order for sidebars.

key.name: profiles
key.description: Each profile is an identifier, a name, a color, the accounts it shows, and its schedule rules. A rule is a weekday bitmask (bit 0 is Monday), a start minute of the day and an end minute of the day; a rule whose end is not after its start wraps past midnight.

key.name: profile-layouts
key.description: Maps a profile identifier to the mail layout it asks for while it is active. A profile that names no layout leaves the default alone. Kept beside the profiles rather than inside them so that profiles written by an older version keep loading.

key.name: default-profile
key.description: Identifier of the profile that applies during hours no schedule rule claims. An empty string shows all accounts.

key.name: override-profile
key.description: Identifier of the profile picked by hand, overriding the schedule. An empty string means all accounts are shown.

key.name: override-until
key.summary: End of the manual profile choice
key.description: Unix time at which the manual choice expires and the schedule takes over again. Zero means no manual choice is in effect.

key.name: selected-folder
key.summary: The account name and folder name of the last selected folder
key.description: The account name and folder name of the last selected folder

key.name: always-show-images
key.description: If enabled, all images will be displayed automatically.

key.name: load-bimi-images
key.description: If enabled, all avatar images are loaded from BIMI TXT records.

key.name: mark-read-timeout
key.description: How long it should take until a selected mail is marked read.

key.name: play-incoming-sound
key.description: Play an sound for new incoming mails.

key.name: important-first
key.description: Whether to move important mails on top.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Defines in which refresh interval mail folders should be checked for changes.

key.name: layout
key.summary: How the mail view arranges its panes
key.description: Side by side puts the conversation list and the reading pane next to each other; stacked puts the reading pane below the list; dense is stacked with the agenda moved into a pane of its own on the right. A profile can override this while it is active.

key.name: profile-folders
key.summary: Where each profile was last reading
key.description: Maps a profile identifier to the account name and folder that profile was last showing, so that switching back to it returns to that folder rather than to someone else's inbox. The empty identifier is the no-profile case.

key.name: agenda-expanded
key.description: Whether the agenda at the bottom of the mail sidebar shows its calendar, so another day can be picked.

key.name: selected-book
key.summary: The account name and book name of the last selected book
key.description: The account name and book name of the last selected book

key.name: expanded
key.summary: Whether the account itself is expanded
key.description: Whether the account itself is expanded

key.name: expanded-folders
key.summary: The list of all the expanded folders
key.description: The list of all the expanded folders

key.name: notification-mode
key.description: Controls which folders trigger notifications: 'inbox', 'all', or 'custom'

key.name: notification-folders
key.summary: Custom notification folders for this account
key.description: List of folder full names that trigger notifications when notification-mode is 'custom'

key.name: default-signature
key.description: The UID of the default signature to auto-insert in new mails.

key.name: pgp-key-id
key.description: The ID of the OpenPGP key used for signing and encryption.

key.name: smime-sign-cert
key.description: The nickname of the S/MIME certificate used for signing.

key.name: smime-encrypt-cert
key.description: The nickname of the S/MIME certificate used for encryption.
